prompt: Luxury editorial photograph for a fragrance magazine. Warm natural window light, shallow depth of field, muted warm palette (ivory, travertine, brass, deep green), tactile textures, cinematic composition, photorealistic, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no branded bottles. Editorial photoreal 3:2 still life. A travertine table set with two deliberate pairings: on the left a rested seared steak on a plain ceramic plate beside a glass of dark tannic red wine; on the right a wedge of blue-veined cheese on a wooden board beside a small glass of amber sweet wine. Linen napkin, one brass-handled knife. Warm raking side light from a west window, long soft shadows, deep green sprig of herb as the only colour accent. Shot at 50mm, food styled honestly rather than glossily. No text, no labels, no logos on the bottles or glassware.
